# Easel source snapshot

The source in this directory comes from [ZJU-REAL/Easel](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Easel) at commit `011e10d86711c7ace3cbb01153f8915dbd018020`. It contains Easel's complete Web application, built-in skills and shared scripts. The top-level Easel license and original component notices are included. The vendored `skills/builtin/gzh-design` component is covered by its own AGPL-3.0 license.

Nous integration code lives outside this directory. The vendored Chat page uses a relative upload-limits URL so it works under the `/creative/` gateway prefix. The other source and assets in this directory come from the pinned commit.
